BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has announced the purchase of 626,329 ordinary shares for cancellation between May 4th and May 8th, 2026, as part of its £50 million share repurchase program. The weighted average purchase price during this period was approximately 257.77 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company now holds no shares in treasury, with 1,410,520,253 ordinary shares remaining in issue, resulting in a total of 1,410,520,253 voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 08 May 2026 8 May 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transactions in own shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 4 May 2026 to 8 May 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from UBS AG London Branch ("UBS") as part of its £50 million share repurchase programme announced on 5 January 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from UBS as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE").
